comment: canonical primary-key encoding vectors. asserted by the native build (crates/sync-core/src/value.rs, serde_json preserve_order ON) and the wasm build (packages/sync-cf-host/canonical-pk.test.mjs, sorted maps). every vector deliberately supplies `pk` with its keys in an order that differs from `primaryKey`, so an encoder that leans on serde_json's map ordering produces the wrong string under at least one build.

vectors.name: composite key supplied in reverse declared order
composite key whose declared order is not alphabetical
three columns, declared order neither insertion nor sorted
missing column encodes as null rather than being dropped
quotes and backslashes escape like serde_json object keys
unicode column name and value stay unescaped
non-ascii column names order by schema, never by codepoint
